title: ormosia costulata var. trifoliolata
intro: Ormosia costulata var. trifoliolata, commonly known as the Trifoliate Ormosia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Trifoliate Ormosia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential pharmacological effects.
